title: Pollen packs move to Stripe checkout
summary:
Pollen packs gained Stripe checkout, while image, Claude, and API-key fixes removed some avoidable request failures.

Stripe checkout was added for $5, $10, $20, and $50 Pollen packs, replacing Polar on the pack buttons. It supports promotion codes, automatic tax, VAT IDs, and invoices. The beta multiplier doubles credits calculated from the amount paid before tax and after discounts.

Image requests without a `model` parameter now use the default instead of returning 400. Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5 fallback configurations now supply the `max_tokens` value required by Vertex AI, while preserving values set by callers.

The API-key verification limit rose from 5 to 10,000 requests per second, reducing erroneous 401 responses during concurrent, high-volume traffic.
